g.text: So... Lettie, look... I know you already said "no" to Amir's game, but...
Hey, Lettie, we're friends, now, yeah? You like me now, ish?
Hey Lettie, what do you think about tabletop roleplaying games?
Hey Lettie, I have a favor to ask you.
Amir is making you ask I know it
I know a game like "Fables & Frontiers" sounds really silly, but it's about spending time together.
I know a game like "Fables & Frontiers" sounds really silly, but it's important to Amir.
I agreed to ask, I think it'll be fun!
I agreed to ask, it's important to him.
Amir's putting together a game of Fables & Frontiers. And I know it sounds silly, but before you come over here and stab me -
I have too much shit to do
Than to waste it on games for children
It's a chance to get everybody to spend time together.
And it might actually be a little fun.
And you could use a break.
...And you wouldn't be the only one playing with us?
Who else have you talked into this?
...And you DO kind of owe me a favor, don't you?
Me and Amir, obviously. And after that...
Lo siento, I just have so much shit to do
You'll have to go on without me
But I better not regret this...
Eleanor said yes, not sure if that's helping or hurting my case...
Of course the bruja wants to waste time
How much did you pay him
HAH... well, if mi hermano is playing...
